messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: *** stan-dev/stan repository moving to stan-dev/stan-future ***
parts:
For the developers: execute these commands from your current local Stan repository:

> git remote rm origin
> git remote add origin https://github.com/stan-dev/stan-future.git

If you don't want to read any further, that's fine. Just type in the lines above.

---------

After all the discussion, we're going to follow the workflow that's outlined here:
http://nvie.com/posts/a-successful-git-branching-model/

In order to enforce the branches 'master' and 'develop' are well maintained, these are going to be in the repository 'stan'. Developers will have to issue pull requests to get things from feature branches onto the 'stan/develop' branch.



Daniel

parts:
Sorry, use this command instead:

> git remote set-url origin https://github.com/stan-dev/stan-future.git


-------------------

> git branch --set-upstream master origin/master

For those that did follow those directions, run this:
> git remote set-url origin https://github.com/stan-dev/stan.git

We can't fork a repository into the same user through github. This was all a workaround for trying to limit what people could do on branches.
